_comment: Tickers whose PRICE HISTORY is unverifiable inside the backtest window, not tickers whose returns are inconvenient. All 19 are 'mixed source' names: their series is mostly source='fyers' (already corporate-action adjusted, adj_factor=1.0) with a few legacy source=NULL rows filling dates Fyers lacked. Those island rows sit on a different adjustment basis, so the price dives and returns within days -- e.g. SURYAROSNI 2016-04-07..04-11 falls to 0.23x then recovers 4.58x. A backtest holding one across that date fires every stop-loss and then books a fabricated multi-bagger. Measured enrichment: 14.5% of source transitions produce a >50% one-day move versus 0.001% of ordinary bars (~10,000x), and 88 of 89 such breaks have no corporate action to explain them. Scope: the 51 additional breaks that sit before 2009-04-01 are NOT listed here -- backtests start at 2009-04-01, which already excludes the 2007-01-02 legacy/Fyers seam (INFY 5.1x, COFORGE 11.9x, BAJFINANCE 101x). This is a stopgap (user decision 2026-08-13, option 2). The fuller fix is to delete the ~2,000 legacy island rows for mixed tickers so the dates read as genuine gaps -- a missing price is honest, a wrong one is not -- which the engine already handles as data_gaps/blackout. Revisit after Phase 6. Never modify OHLC prices for corporate actions: Fyers data arrives pre-adjusted and rewriting it would corrupt the primary dataset.
